_doc: Friday remote feature flags. Each app: `easProjectId`+`bundleId` identify the binary; `appStoreBuilds` lists iOS buildNumbers (CFBundleVersion strings) that have been submitted to App Store review. App at launch reads own bundleId+buildNumber; if its build is in appStoreBuilds → dev affordances (Bug bildir) hide. TF builds not yet in the list keep them visible. Add a buildNumber here right BEFORE clicking 'Submit for Review' in ASC.
